errors.evidence: The description identifies the chart as a horizontal bar chart ('horizontales Balkendiagramm'), but it is a vertical bar chart (column chart), as the bars are oriented vertically.

The description states the y-axis has intervals of -5 ('in Intervallen von -5'). While numerically correct in terms of progression, intervals are conventionally described as positive values (i.e., 'in intervals of 5'). This phrasing is non-standard.

The prompt asks to state whether the bars are sorted in a particular order. The description lists the order of the categories but does not explicitly state that they are not sorted (e.g., by value or alphabetically).
